evidence: Verified the error set in /home/labdrian/labdrian-sdd-overlay-worktrees/review-6a4e0cd98b68/engine/reviewresult/errors.go: shapeRefusals lists exactly the shape errors (ErrUnparseable, ErrUnknownMember, ErrMissingID, ErrDuplicateID, ErrOutsideEnum, ErrMissingProof) and excludes ErrCandidateMismatch, ErrInspectionNotCompleted, ErrPathsMismatch and ErrInvalidBinding, so binding/inspection refusals are not re-asked, as intended and documented.
Launch re-asks at most once; a reviewer error on the re-ask is returned as is; a re-ask over review.MaxReplyBytes falls back to the first refusal; any other first error is returned unchanged.

The four new tests cover the intent: shape refusal then success, second refusal returned after two calls, binding mismatch with no re-ask, and re-ask over the bound with no re-ask (not executed by this reviewer).
README.md, engine/cmd/usage.go and bin/lib/usage.sh describe the behavior the code implements.
